title: in / on / at para hablar del tiempo

rule.title: Prepositions of time: in, on, at
rule.explanation:
**at** para un momento concreto: la hora y algunas expresiones fijas: at seven o'clock, at half past nine, at night, at lunchtime, at the weekend, at Christmas.

**on** para los días y las fechas: on Monday, on Friday evening, on 3 May, on my birthday.

**in** para periodos más largos: meses, estaciones, años y partes del día: in June, in winter, in 2025, in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening.

Ojo: in the morning, pero on Monday morning (cuando dices el día, manda el día). Y at night, no «in the night».

Sin preposición delante de this, next, last, every, today, tomorrow y yesterday: I'm busy this Friday. See you next week.
examples: The meeting is at ten o'clock.
I study in the evening, but I don't work at night.

sets.instructions: Completa con in, on o at.

items.sentence: The bus leaves ___ quarter past eight.
Lucía has an English class ___ Tuesday.

items.explanation: Parte del día: in the evening.

items.sentence: Sam plays with his band ___ Saturday night.
items.explanation: Con el día delante, on: on Saturday night.

items.sentence: Priya sleeps in the day because she works ___ night.
We eat a lot of chocolate ___ Easter.
I have lunch ___ half past one.

items.explanation: En inglés británico: at the weekend.

items.sentence: The market is open ___ Sunday mornings.
Javi gets up late ___ the morning.
items.explanation: Parte del día: in the morning.

items.sentence: We have a party ___ New Year's Eve.
items.explanation: Un día concreto: on New Year's Eve.

items.sentence: The office is closed ___ Christmas Day.
items.explanation: Un día concreto: on Christmas Day. Pero at Christmas (las fiestas).

items.question: Ceno a las ocho.
options: I have dinner in eight o'clock.
I have dinner at eight o'clock.

items.question: Trabajo por la tarde.
items.explanation: Parte del día sola: in the afternoon.

items.question: Nos vemos el viernes que viene.
items.explanation: Con next no se pone preposición.

items.question: Juego al tenis el sábado por la mañana.
options: I play tennis in Saturday morning.
I play tennis on Saturday morning.
items.explanation: Si dices el día, manda el día: on Saturday morning.

items.question: Estoy ocupada este jueves.
items.explanation: Con this no se pone preposición.

items.question: Vamos a Escocia en invierno.
options: We go to Scotland at winter.
We go to Scotland in winter.

items.question: Llegué ayer.
items.explanation: Con yesterday, today y tomorrow no hay preposición.

sets.instructions: Cada frase tiene un error con in, on o at. Escríbela bien.
